title: Virtuoso Optoelectronics Ltd - 543597 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: FY26 revenue rose about 18% to INR823 crore and EBITDA reached about INR86 crore (10.4% margin), with Q4 revenue at about INR317 crore.
summary.overview: Management described FY26 as a recovery year after a difficult H1, with consolidated revenue of about INR823 crore (up about 18%), EBITDA up from about INR60 crore to about INR86 crore, and margin up from 8.6% to 10.4%. PAT rose to about INR15 crore (1.8% margin) from about INR12 crore, while PBT was flat, which management attributed partly to the first year of Ind AS (including right-of-use asset effects). Q4 revenue was about INR317 crore versus INR240 crore a year earlier. Management is guiding to a 35-40% revenue CAGR over three to five years and is expanding capacity in EMS, AC, refrigeration and compressors, with the new compressor line in commercial production since January 2026.

financial_highlights.change: from INR240 crore in Q4 FY25

financial_highlights.value: described as normal, in line with expectations

segments.name: Air conditioners (AC)
segments.commentary: Share of revenue fell from about 70-75% to about 60% in FY26; ODM share of AC revenue was 40-50%. Company now has 4 AC customers and expects 1-2 new names next season. Average realisation about INR20,000-20,000-odd per unit.

segments.name: EMS and lighting
segments.commentary: About 15% of revenue; running at 70-80% utilisation through the year. Capacity to rise from 4 lakh CPH to 8 lakh (phase 1, by about end-August 2026) and 12 lakh (phase 2, by FY-end).

segments.name: Commercial refrigeration / defreezers
segments.commentary: About 10% of revenue; utilisation about 60%. Capacity 1.5 lakh units to 2.5 lakh (phase 1) and 4 lakh (phase 2); glass-top range added alongside hardtop. Target RAC-type growth of 30-40% in FY27.

segments.name: Components
segments.commentary: About 7% of revenue and rising; a major contributor to margin protection in the first nine months.

segments.name: Compressors (reciprocating, new subsidiary Virtuoso Compressors)
segments.commentary: Commercial production began January 2026 at about 60% utilisation on 2.8 million capacity, targeting about 80% in 2-3 months; expansion to 6 million by March 2027. Average realisation INR1,400-1,500; FY27 margin guided at 6-7%; value addition 5-10%.

guidance_outlook: Revenue CAGR of 35-40% over three to five years, applied to the INR825 crore base; management said it is not revising guidance, with exact numbers to be shared during the year.
EBITDA margin for FY27 guided at 9-10%, described as 'closer to double digits'; management called 12% a wishful number.
PAT margin expected to improve by 50-100 bps over the next two years as Ind AS adjustments fade.
Compressor margin 6-7% in FY27, potentially above double digits over 2-4 years as Chinese imports restrict and backward integration rises (11-12% in 4-5 years).
RAC utilisation target of 60-65% and volume growth of about 30-40% in FY27.
Chennai plant expected to contribute about 5-6% of volume in its first year.
Peak-utilisation revenue capacity from the current expansion is good for beyond INR2,500 crore, but management said reaching that from INR800 crore in two years is a big ask and will take more time.
HoldCo net debt addition of about INR50-60 crore in FY27; INR150 crore debt at the compressor subsidiary; INR250 crore equity approval is a blanket enabling approval, not a fundraising commitment.
capex_capacity: Compressors: capacity 2.8 million to 6 million by March 2027 (9-10 month build), INR150 crore phase-1 investment, already tied up; long-term target 8-8.5 million, with 7.5 million or 9.5 million considered if demand and contracts materialise.
AC: capacity about 1 million to 1.8 million by end FY27, with 1.3 million targeted before the next AC season; investment INR40-50 crore, mainly debt-funded, with some debt already tied up.
EMS: new advanced facility; phase 1 by end-August 2026 and phase 2 by FY-end; investment about INR25 crore, tied up.
Refrigeration: two phases at about INR20-25 crore each (INR25-50 crore total); first phase to be completed before the next AC season.
Compressor separate manufacturing facility planned at Nasik; development work to start shortly. New Nasik tool room operational.
demand_pricing: Raw-material pass-through about 10-15% across the industry from manufacturers to brands and to consumers; management said margin pressure was offset by customer price hikes, new customers, old inventory, subsidies and product diversification.
Management expects AC margins to hold at current levels in FY27 barring macro shocks, while noting ODM margins are not yet ideal.

Government restricts reciprocating compressor imports to 40% of FY24-25 base-year levels, meaning 50-60% of OEM/ODM requirement must be sourced locally; the company says it is the only OEM/ODM player currently doing this.

Two competitors expected to start local compressor manufacturing (one by end-Q3/Q4 FY27, one mid-2027). Management estimates a market gap of 14-15 million units against total planned capacity of 15-18 million.
Demand described as strong for AC; April-June 2026 expected to be an excellent quarter for RAC. Management said AC demand runway is long because the base is small.
PLI: no concrete roadmap for renewal beyond this year; government said to be considering options.

qa_highlights.question: What price hikes have been taken in AC and will margins hold in FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: Price hikes have covered raw-material pressure but not added real gains; management expects margins to stay at current levels absent macro shocks.

qa_highlights.question: What is the timeline and funding for the capacity expansion?
qa_highlights.answer: EMS phase 1 in about 3 months, AC to 1.3 million before the season and 1.8 million within FY27, refrigeration phase 1 before the next season, and compressors 2.8 to 6 million by March. Compressor (INR150 crore) and EMS (INR25 crore) are funded; AC (INR40-50 crore) will largely be debt-funded.

qa_highlights.question: What are the FY27 margin and realisation expectations for compressors and the company overall?
qa_highlights.answer: Compressor margin 6-7% in FY27; company EBITDA margin 9-10%. Compressor realisation about INR1,400-1,500 per unit. Management said 12% margin is wishful.

qa_highlights.question: Why is FY27 revenue guidance lower than the INR1,200 crore target previously mentioned?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it is not revising guidance; the 35-40% CAGR on the INR825 crore base implies a figure near INR1,000 crore.

qa_highlights.question: Will the compressor capacity to 6 million be enough, and how does the QCO affect the 7.5 million plan?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said 6 million is the first target; the drop from 7 million was line optimisation, not government action. Further growth to 7.5-9.5 million depends on long-term contracts; the INR150 crore subsidiary debt is enough for the 6 million target.

qa_highlights.question: What is the mainboard migration timeline?
qa_highlights.answer: BSE in-principle approval received; NSE expected within a week, followed by 4-6 weeks for migration and listing, so possibly by end-August per management.

risks_watch: Execution risk on the expansion plan: management said in the call that 100% execution is not in its control, and an earlier 150K-to-400K capacity plan was not delivered.
Competitive entry in compressors (two new local players in 2026-27) could affect utilisation and pricing once the 40% import allowance is revised.
Raw-material volatility with only 10-15% pass-through; margins below peers in ODM AC business.
Dependence on AC is still about 60% of revenue; demand is seasonal and utilisation figures are highly seasonal.
Revenue guidance ambiguity: the 35-40% CAGR implies about INR1,000 crore base, while the earlier INR1,200 crore target was not revised explicitly.
Debt and equity plans (HoldCo debt INR50-60 crore; INR250 crore equity blanket approval) need monitoring; the company said it will look at funding requirements over the next 1-3 months.
Possible PLI expiry after FY26 with no roadmap yet.
Product-wise FY26 revenue split was given only for nine months in the presentation; management said this would be corrected to a 12-month basis.
summary.management_tone: Confident on demand, capacity and the compressor opportunity, with a clear focus on diversification. Cautious and hedged on margins, RM pass-through and the competitive landscape, and noncommittal on the FY27 revenue target and the timing of expansion, repeatedly saying plans are not fully within management's control.
key_quotes: Going forward in this year also, we expect the margins to remain where they are, unless of course there are any other macroeconomic jolts.

So, we believe there will be two or three players in this segment active in a year or two, which also makes for healthy competition, but we still believe that 6 million is a number that we will be able to fill.
This is a very wishful number. I think we will try and keep it closer to double digits.

growth.why: Management guides 35-40% revenue CAGR over three to five years on an INR825 crore base and FY27 EBITDA margin of 9-10%, backed by named capacity adds (compressors 2.8m to 6m, AC to 1.8m, EMS and refrigeration phases) with capex mostly tied up, though the CAGR itself lacks a year-by-year build and compressor capacity was cut from 7m.
